description: December 29 birthday meaning: Capricorn decan 1, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a December 29 birthday falls in Capricorn, in the first decan, with Saturn as the sign's ruler and Saturn as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Capricorn is cardinal and earth.

sections.heading: The December 29 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Capricorn's practicality and the master number 11's intuition make December 29 a quietly visionary date. With the Sun at seven degrees of the sign, in Saturn's decan, inspiration tends to be tested before it is trusted. The interpretive portrait is a grounded idealist: someone who sees what could be and has the patience to make it real.

Astronomically, December 29 puts the Sun near 7° Capricorn in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Saturn. Saturn rules Capricorn and also governs the sign's first decan, which spans roughly December 22 to December 31. Birthdays here arrive at the turning point of the year, and this decan is traditionally read as the sign in its most concentrated form: patient, ambitious, realistic and willing to climb slowly. Responsibility often arrives early in life for these natives. Doubled Saturn can make them hard on themselves and reluctant to rest until the work is complete. Their quiet authority tends to grow with age, and humour, usually dry, is one of the ways they lighten what they carry.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for December 29
paragraphs: Born on the 29th, your compound is 2 + 9 = 11, and because 11 is a master number it is kept as 11 rather than reduced to 2. The 2 brings sensitivity, the 9 brings compassion and breadth, and together they create one of the most intuitive birthday numbers. People born on the 29th are often described as emotionally perceptive, idealistic and capable of inspiring others. Their feelings can run high, with marked highs and lows. As a secondary number, the 29 tends to reward creative and caring outlets for that intensity, and rest between them.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a December 29 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous December 29 birthdays
paragraphs: December birthdays arrive at the start of northern winter, around the shortest days and the year's festivities, and at the start of summer in the southern hemisphere. Sagittarius holds most of the month, with Capricorn beginning around December 21 or 22. In numerology December is month 12, which reduces to 3: expression and sociability, built from the 1 and 2 of initiative and partnership. December 29 is the 363rd day of the year (364th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Aquarius, is usually complete within 23 days, by January 21.

By December 29 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a December 29 birthday are Andrew Johnson (1808), Jon Voight (1938) and William Ewart Gladstone (1809).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is December 29?
faq.answer: December 29 is Capricorn in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Capricorn, which tradition links with Saturn.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on December 29?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On December 29 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 22 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 29th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on December 29?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by December 29, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on December 29?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on December 29 include Andrew Johnson (1808), Jon Voight (1938) and William Ewart Gladstone (1809). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
